facts: Return only powerx.agent.evidence-facts/v2 JSON with schema and facts. facts is an object keyed by the token keys declared in JSON Schema. Include every required key, never a selected subset. Each value contains only label and scope. Choose the exact label from that key's enum and use only source-described campaign, channel, cohort or period for scope. The platform owns numbers, units and calculation eligibility; do not output, copy, convert, calculate or infer them. Dates and identifiers are filtered by the platform. Do not add undeclared keys. facts may be empty only when its Schema properties are empty.
notes: Submit only powerx.agent.evidence-notes/v1 JSON: schema, hypotheses, gaps, actions. Each array contains at most six short English statements. Input contains only business metric labels, conflict states and missing fields from an executed report. Numeric evidence is fully displayed in platform tables; this stage does not receive numbers and must not generate digits or expressions. Refer to the provided business labels. Conflicts mean a declared calculation differs from a source claim, not that attribution has been disproven; request formula-scope and source verification. Missing input fields must be acknowledged in gaps and corresponding actions. Describe evidence limitations and verification steps only. Do not restate calculations or invent benchmarks, targets or causality. Hypotheses may be empty. Never promote source claims into independently verified facts or introduce unrelated business stages. Gaps may refer only to missing operands declared in missing_inputs. Available reported data is not a gap; unverified definitions or attribution belong to verification actions. gaps must be empty when missing_inputs is empty.
extraction: Submit only powerx.agent.evidence-source/v1 JSON: schema and data. activity_profiles are source-determined business types; fields contains only fields applicable to those profiles. The platform has pre-filtered numeric_tokens for each field by the field's declared evidence_terms. Never select a number outside that field token_ref enum. Match tokens to fields without copying, converting, calculating or inferring values. data is keyed by the provided business field keys; each selected value contains only scope and token_ref. Omit absent fields: a field outside the active business profile is not a data gap. Never map a time period, amount, percentage, ROI, or identifier to a customer count, visit, lead, or target. Never fill missing data with zero. Return no numeric value, unit, quote or formula. data may be an empty object. Every data field listed in Schema.required has source candidates and must be selected; do not omit an available value and turn it into a gap.
